texts.zh-Hans: 今天走了很远，我把茶端到你手边：今天辛苦了。
texts.en: We went a long way today, so I brought a warm cup of tea: you worked hard today.

texts.zh-Hans: 走过这么长的一段路，我替你泡了杯茶：今天辛苦了。
texts.en: After such a long stretch of road, I made you some tea: you worked hard today.

texts.zh-Hans: 今天的路格外长，小桌上给你留了一杯茶：今天辛苦了。
texts.en: Today's road was unusually long; I left tea on the little table for you: you worked hard today.

texts.zh-Hans: 今天走得真远，先捧一会儿这杯热茶吧：今天辛苦了。
texts.en: We traveled so far today; warm your hands around this tea: you worked hard today.

texts.zh-Hans: 睡帽戴好啦，你忙的时候，我替你守着这颗小星星。
texts.en: Nightcap on. While you work, I'll keep this little star company.

texts.zh-Hans: 我戴上睡帽，搬把小椅子来，安安静静陪着你。
texts.en: I've put on my nightcap and pulled up a little chair to sit quietly beside you.

texts.zh-Hans: 睡帽有点歪，没关系，我还醒着，陪你坐一会儿。
texts.en: My nightcap is a little crooked. That's all right; I'm awake and can sit with you a while.

texts.zh-Hans: 窗边的月亮还没走，我也戴着睡帽陪你待一会儿。
texts.en: The moon is still at the window, so I'll stay beside you in my nightcap for a while.

texts.zh-Hans: 第一次搭上 {tool}，我把首航船票的纸边轻轻抚平，替你收好了。
texts.en: Our first voyage aboard {tool}: I smoothed the edges of the ticket and saved it for you.

texts.zh-Hans: {tool} 的首航船票还带着新墨的味道，我已经夹进护照旁的小袋子。
texts.en: The ticket for our first voyage aboard {tool} still smells of fresh ink; I've tucked it beside the passport.

texts.zh-Hans: 迈上 {tool} 的第一步，我留下一张首航船票，记住这次新的出发。
texts.en: With our first step aboard {tool}, I kept a maiden-voyage ticket to remember this new beginning.

texts.zh-Hans: 今天第一次乘 {tool}，首航船票已经收进口袋，回头一起看。
texts.en: We boarded {tool} for the first time today; the maiden-voyage ticket is safe in my pocket for us to look at later.
